newsitem.title: USA: Wis. center sells naming rights to Midwest Express.
newsitem.headline: Wis. center sells naming rights to Midwest Express.

text.p: Midwest Express Airlines has entered into an agreement to purchase the naming rights of a new bond-financed convention center in Milwaukee, airline, state of Wisconsin and city officials announced Wednesday.

The Milwaukee-based airline agreed to pay $9.25 million over 15 years to name facility the Midwest Express Center. Finalization of the agreement will be taken up by the Wisconsin Center District board, a state-create agency overseeing the development of the $170 million, bond-financed facility, at its March 5 meeting.
The agreement over naming rights is believed to be the first corporate sponsorship of a non-sports related convention facility in the United States, according to a press release.
The 800,000 square foot convention center is scheduled to open in July 1998.
